reclassification: The v2 run stopped at the user's safe checkpoint after 200 of 999 controls. v3 is a continuation with an explicit partial-integrity check and a corrected four-view record string; it does not count the already completed 200 controls as a new independent sample or change any scientific decision rule.
basis: FEED-011 proposes prefix-fit/postfix-prediction calibration and warns that ciphertext complexity does not identify hidden key complexity.
The LP2 corpus is already registered as rune ordinals 0..28; BM is a new measurement target, not a rerun of H017's language score.
The user explicitly authorized original, difference, prime-derived and totient-derived views with F29 Berlekamp--Massey.
H030-v2 has a verified gate and formal observed output, but its user-paused control stream contains only 200 of 999 completed replicates; v3 completes that same frozen stream.
hypothesis: At least one preregistered representation of a page has a fixed low-order F29 recurrence whose coefficients fitted on the first two thirds predict the untouched final third exactly, beyond the page-preserving random controls.
falsifiable_predictions: The four fixed views below are computed without searching offsets, skips, concatenations, GP-value projections or alternate initial values.
The synthetic gate detects at least 18/20 low-order recurrence positives and accepts 0/99 random, frequency-biased or changed-tail negatives under the fixed prediction rule.

A formal LP2 lead must pass both low-complexity and exact-tail-prediction maxT p<=0.003, have every untouched suffix symbol correct, and be present in the fixed holdout partition, not only the discovery partition.
The 200 previously written controls must reproduce byte-for-byte at the row/metric level before controls 200..998 are accepted; a mismatch is an execution error, not a negative.

sources.role: Previous frozen scientific protocol and four-view contract.
User-paused v2 execution record and 200-control checkpoint.
Existing partial controls to be independently checked and continued.
Frozen v2 page, view, partition and statistic contract used to validate continuation.
Pinned LP2 raw corpus and page applicability.
BM prefix/postfix observability proposal and limitations.
Non-duplication boundary: H017 language-scored first difference is not BM complexity.

applicable_objects: All 55 rune-bearing pages; discovery D=LP2/0..27, holdout H=LP2/28..55 excluding LP2/50. Pages/views with N<96 are descriptive only and explicitly inconclusive_short.

excluded_objects.reason: No registered rune tokens; no conversion of the alphanumeric grid.

views.difference: C_(i+1)-C_i mod29, length N-1, no artificial initial term

algorithm_version: H030-v3 continuation: BM recurrence s_t + sum(c_j*s_(t-j))=0 mod29; fit first floor(2N/3), predict the untouched suffix recursively using only predicted values; four views only.

parameters.non_rune_policy: B uses only the rune sequence; no non-rune consumes position or resets

statistics.controls: Each of 999 controls first permutes the original C within each page, then regenerates all four views and refits BM. Replicates are indexed 0..998 and generated by Random(CONTROL_SEED + replicate).
statistics.maxT: Separate maxT correction for T_L and T_P across at most 55*4=220 eligible page-view cells; the two statistics share the item family and alpha is 0.01/3=0.003. Holm is not used as a second gate.
statistics.lead: Order within cap, every held-out suffix symbol exact, both maxT p values pass, independent finite-field recurrence/minimal-order checks for capped candidates pass, and the signal is present in H.
statistics.negative: Complete gate, 999 controls, independent verification and no lead; scope is limited to the four views and fixed protocol.
statistics.resume: The first 200 rows are accepted only after exact recomputation; rows 200..998 are generated with the same deterministic replicate mapping and combined before statistics.

power_gate.acceptance: At least 18/20 public sequences pass raw-view order/prediction acceptance and 0/99 negatives do; failure is inconclusive and no LP2 batch is interpreted.

controls.null: Independent within-page permutation of original C before all four views
controls.multiple_testing: Both statistics use maxT across the complete eligible page-view family; no 7/14/28 special threshold.

continuation.partial_policy: Validate source row IDs, input digests and compact metrics; preserve source rows unchanged and append only the missing deterministic rows.

independent_validation_path: A second implementation recomputes BM by direct finite-field discrepancy updates, verifies every prefix equation and recurrence, regenerates each view independently, replays the held-out prediction, and validates every resumed source row before it enters the combined statistic matrix.
uncovered_parameters: alternate page concatenation, offsets, skips, clocks and resets
